name: @nwparagliding/windgram
description: Faithful TypeScript port of the rasp-windgram Python renderer (render_windgram). Draws a soaring windgram to a 2D canvas from a forecast-cube data column.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2020 --outfile=../site/v2/windgram.js --banner:js="/* Generated from windgram-ts/ — do not edit by hand. Source of truth: rasp-windgram/rasp/windgram.py + soaring.py */"
